copy.tagline: 生成 WebGL 风流体背景与金句叠加动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或网页中快速生成动态流体背景
copy.tagline_en: Generate WebGL fluid background with quote overlay animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create dynamic fluid backgrounds for videos or web pages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据你的要求，生成一个单文件HTML：包含WebGL风格的流体背景（支持CSS、Canvas或WebGL三种实现），并在顶部叠加你提供的金句文字。你可以选择横屏或竖屏、四种调色板之一。
howto.when: 当你说出“流体背景Hero帧”、“视频片头”或“海报底图”等关键词时，Claude会接管并生成该页面。

say.text: 用Forest Mint配色生成WebGL流体海报，文字‘生长’。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a single-file HTML with a fluid background (CSS, Canvas, or WebGL) and overlay your provided quote. You can choose orientation and one of four palettes.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'fluid background hero frame', 'video intro', or 'poster background', Claude will take over and generate the page.

say_en.text: Generate a fluid background hero frame, portrait, Aurora Violet palette, quote 'The future is here'.
say_en.note: Directly creates a single-file HTML with specified style.

say_en.text: Make a WebGL fluid poster with Forest Mint palette, text 'Growth'.
